root: ^“Now we are in the clear. Let’s grab the sword that Borjaard stole from our king.” said the commanding raspy voice.
^“We do this silently, and he will never have known we were here.”
^A little later, on their way back to the castle, the girl declared:
^“It was smart of us to wait for the thief to turn his back.
^I can’t imagine that would have been an easy fight.”
^“You are correct, Melissa. That would have been a very tough fight indeed.
^I’m glad we were able to complete this mission safely.
^Remember, sometimes the best strategy is not to fight at all.”
^And so it was that the mission was accomplished with no blood shed.
^A tale of a soldier and a captain that won by stealth, not by drawing their swords.
